The Carr form prints no schedule total.

expenditures.detail: 3 rows sum to EXACTLY 659.32 (363.80 + 145.52 + 150.00), matching the filer's own hand-written 659.32 below the last row and cover line 3 in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns. The FORM prints no schedule total; the 659.32 in schedule_total is the FILER's.

gates.page_subtotal: no printed schedule total on either Carr schedule. p2: single row 500.00 = cover line1 THIS = CUM 500.00 -> closes (line 2's 75.00 small-donor aggregate is deliberately NOT part of this comparison). p3: rows-sum 659.32 = filer's hand-written total = cover line3 -> closes exactly.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p2: ok, 35 bands / 34 data bands, pitch 2.324%, rules from 9.73, 12.55, 14.85 ... the single inked row sits above the 12.55 rule, in the first band; all other bands empty -> 1 row emitted. rowbands.py p3 returns geometry_status 'gaps' (it loses the interior rules exactly where the filer's ink crosses them, the known tool DEBT), so p3 was counted by INK at 200 dpi and re-counted in 600 dpi band crops: three transaction rows (the third's payee name wraps onto a fourth ruled line, 'Chris Wilson', which is a CONTINUATION of row 3's name and carries no digits, no amount and no date - it is not a fourth transaction) plus the filer's total. 3 rows emitted.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: the row's amount-cell crop renders '500.00'; the control one row-pitch below renders empty (only the descender tail of the row above clips the top edge). p3: a single column crop spanning the amount cells renders, in order, 363.80 / 145.52 / 150.00 and then the filer's own 659.32 total two bands below - i.e. the three row boxes hold their own values and the band past the last row holds the total, not a transaction.
gates.balance_chain: contributions 500.00 + 75.00 = 575.00; minus expenses 659.32 = -84.32. Cover line 4 instead reads a POSITIVE 659.32 in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns - the same 'expense figure copied into the balance line' pattern seen on keys ab1fa1ef and 84204cb6 in this chunk. Does NOT close; FILER arithmetic, both figures retained verbatim, nothing recomputed. No second filing by this filer is in this chunk, so no cross-filing chain was available.
